title: Tech Note: Disabling Tab Controls
featured_technology: Automatic action / 'go to page' method pattern

historical_commentary.text: This note compares two ways to restrict access to certain form pages navigated via tab controls (associated with either an automatic action or a custom 'go to page' method): disabling the tab control outright, or deleting it. Tab controls and the underlying need to conditionally restrict navigation remain a completely standard, still-current 4D form design pattern, so this note's guidance is directly usable by developers building binary or Project Mode forms today with little modification.
related_updates: Tab controls and their enable/disable behavior remain unchanged in current 4D form design, in both Design Mode and Project Mode
